says.t: At Micron, phones and PCs were $13.1bn of $54.2bn in June-August sales, or 24%, against $34.3bn from data centers.

Micron at its lows, on the last four quarters of profit: 2.4 times in December 2018, 6.3 in September 2022, 10.2 in May 2016 and 15.5 in April 2025.
SanDisk said on 29 October that one wafer takes about 120 days to make.
SanDisk's worst quarter is January-March 2027 on all three lines.

SanDisk's April-June 2027 rise on the prior quarter is +29.4% on AI upside, +24% on the Base case and +17% on the Measured slowdown, and on the Measured slowdown its sales then fall about 2% in each of the last two quarters of 2027.
From 26 October to 1 November the AI chain had 7 broker rating cuts, 4 of them on Intel and none on Micron, SanDisk, Western Digital, Nvidia or AMD, and 71 target cuts.
The 7 rating cuts are Seagate, Alphabet, Microsoft and Intel four times, and the 6 raises are Intel twice, Broadcom, GE Vernova, Monolithic Power and Microsoft.

says.t: Apple said on 2 November that memory pricing is "unprecedented", that its purchase prices keep rising, and that memory will limit Mac and iPad supply in October-December.
Apple is unlikely to show bad phone and PC numbers on 2 November, because the new iPhones are strong and it has carry-in inventory of memory.
Apple reported on 2 November 2026 what the phone and PC story said it would: strong demand now, with memory arriving in the margin.
The chip sellers feel it first: Qualcomm's chip unit $9.02bn, down $0.80bn; Intel PC chips about $8.09bn, down about $0.45bn; AMD client and gaming $3.72bn, down $0.33bn.
Qualcomm on 4 November showed both sides.

On the harder test, AI beating the PC loss on a year earlier, the lag is about 4 to 7 months: Intel about 22 July 2027 or 28 October on the tougher path, and Qualcomm about 28 July on the tougher path (on the Base case its guide is already above a year earlier about 3 February).

Intel beat EPS by 27.9% and fell 28.6%, its worst day in data back to 1985, because it guided October-December sales to $15-16bn and adjusted EPS to $0.25, against about $16.7bn and $0.39 from analysts, and planned for PC units to shrink about 10% in 2027.
On 29 October Intel said PC market units fall about 12% in 2026 and about 10% in 2027, and that its own PC chip sales fall more than 20% in October-December from July-September.
Intel said on 29 October that its PC chip sales fall more than 20% in October-December from July-September, and that PC market units fall about 12% in 2026 and about 10% in 2027.

says.t: Each lowest-sales report except HP's also brings a guide that turns up, Samsung's about 22 days after its preliminary figures, so the count falls to 1, HP, by late May.

That ends the first wave only: HP never turns, phones and PCs have no true recovery before 2028, the storage rebound is weaker after the wafer's fall, and the words on 2028 spending decide the ending.
HP's first bad outlook was 25 November 2025.

Dell and HP report on 24 November for August to October, so buying in November to January only shows in their late-February reports, and the memory makers feel any change in orders before any of these filings show it.
The first tests are HPE about 23 November and Dell on 24 November: their orders, backlog and stock of goods show whether a pause is starting.
The first test is Dell's report in late November; the big buyers' 2027 plans come in late January and early February.

The 71-72% gross margin Nvidia guides for November-January, reported about 24 February 2027 on our estimate from last year's timing, is below 11 of its last 16 quarters, about level with 2 and above 3.

says.t: AMD forecast October-December sales of about $17bn, plus or minus 3%, on 3 November, against the $16.29bn analysts expected, and its stock closed up 1.0% on 4 November at $488.78.
On 3 November AMD reported July-September sales of $13.38bn and guided October-December to about $17bn, plus or minus 3%, against about $16.29bn expected, at a gross margin of about 55%.
AMD reports on Tuesday 3 November after the 4 PM close, with a call at 5 PM New York time.
